Chapter 760: Chapter 37: Pushing The Door Open (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 760: Chapter 37: Pushing the Door Open (Please Subscribe)

In front of the massive scroll, the half-meter-tall elder seemed somewhat dazed.

He could freely manipulate everything within the two-dimensional world of the scroll, with the entire two-dimensional world appearing as an extension of his own body, down to the smallest detail.

As for the many powerhouses of the Myriad Clans who had fallen into the two-dimensional world? In the eyes of the half-meter-tall elder, there were no secrets, as he could see through them at a glance.

However, it was precisely because of this that the half-meter-tall elder was all the more astonished, his gaze piercing through the entire two-dimensional world, continuously sizing up Lin Yuan, who stood before the heavenly gate.

“Originally, I just wanted to watch for another ten thousand years, to see what this little fellow could do after breaking the limit of the thirty layers of worlds…” the half-meter-tall elder silently thought to himself.

Merely three hundred some years after Lin Yuan’s arrival, he had already broken the limit of the thirty layers of worlds, which left the half-meter-tall elder somewhat uncertain.

...

According to his thoughts, as long as Lin Yuan could continue to break the thirty layers’ limit within the next ten thousand years, that would be enough.

The higher one goes with world limits, the more difficult it becomes to break them; the first thirty layers of world limits are not at all the same concept as the next thirty layers.

That’s why the half-meter-tall elder had specifically set aside ten thousand years.

“I thought I had overestimated enough, that in ten thousand and three hundred some years, breaking through sixty layers of world limits would be enough. I never expected this little guy to far exceed my estimates. In just ten thousand years, he actually broke through ninety-nine layers of world limits?”

The half-meter-tall elder steadied his mind. That is to say, in the ten thousand and three hundred years since Lin Yuan arrived, he had broken through a total of one hundred and twenty-nine layers of world limits.

“Even a Twelfth-Rank Life, transcending the shackles of the River of Time and falling into this low-dimensional space, couldn’t possibly break through so many world limits in just over ten thousand years, right?”

The half-meter-tall elder still couldn’t quite believe it. Even Twelfth-Rank Lives that fell into low-dimensional space could still use some extraordinary methods to accelerate their cultivation speed.

But even so, to reach Lin Yuan’s current level, it would probably take a hundred thousand or even a million years.

“Is he really just a Long River Inner Life?” the half-meter-tall elder confirmed repeatedly. Life below the Twelfth Rank is also called Long River Inner Life, meaning they need to be bound by the River of Time.

Even within the Chaos Void, Long River Inner Life and Long River Outer Life are fundamentally different, with the latter far surpassing the former in every aspect.

This is determined by the essence of life itself; the beings within the River of Time are limited in their perceptions and experiences, which are extremely narrow.

Whereas Twelfth-Rank Lives outside the River of Time can see and feel a universe that is immensely vast and grand.

“This is truly terrifying.” Having confirmed that Lin Yuan was still caught within the River of Time, the half-meter-tall elder’s expression was one of utter amazement.

At this moment, the speed of cultivation that Lin Yuan displayed was the strongest of all Long River Inner Life since the creation of this two-dimensional world.

And he had established a cliff-like gap with the second in line.

Even among the many formidable existences outside the River of Time, Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed was astonishingly fast.

“No need to continue watching, I suppose.”

“Just let him come in.”

The half-meter-tall elder glanced at the heavenly gate that was rapidly taking shape.

If he continued to watch, the half-meter-tall elder even worried that Lin Yuan might continue to break even more world limits, eventually breaking free from the two-dimensional world’s suppression and leaving.

Although the probability of this happening was almost zero, an absolutely impossible feat.

But before this, the half-meter-tall elder had also never imagined that Lin Yuan could break so many layers of world limits within ten thousand years.

…

At the summit of Heavenly Mountain.

Lin Yuan stood before the heavenly gate, his heart slightly stirred by the gate that was rapidly materializing.

All the efforts he made during the ten thousand years in the two-dimensional world were for this moment, to open the gate before him.

Only by opening the heavenly gate was there hope to leave this two-dimensional world.

Only by leaving this two-dimensional world could he avoid intrinsic losses and preserve his Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Only by leaving this two-dimensional world could the countless mysterious artifacts Lin Yuan acquired display their true value.

…

The heavenly gate gradually materialized, also pulling at the hearts and minds of other powerhouses of the Myriad Clans.

These powerhouses of the Myriad Clans, although competitors with Lin Yuan, especially the Four Divine Kings and other Eleventh Rank Perfect Lives, had been living under the shadow cast by Lin Yuan for ten thousand years.

But—

All the powerhouses of the Myriad Clans sincerely hoped that Lin Yuan would be able to push open the heavenly gate.

Only if Lin Yuan could open the heavenly gate would it mean that the gate could be opened, and they too would have the possibility of opening it.

And only after Lin Yuan opened the heavenly gate and left this two-dimensional world would the chance for the Four Divine Kings and other Eleventh Rank Perfect Lives truly come.

As long as Lin Yuan did not leave, no power in this two-dimensional world could compete with him.

The Four Divine Kings had some confidence initially and wanted to challenge Lin Yuan seriously this time.

But just a single sidelong glance from Lin Yuan brought him back to reality.

“Lord Xueyu…”

On the side of Human Civilization, Xuanyuan Dua and other Eleventh-Rank Evolvers from Human Civilization watched Lin Yuan before the heavenly gate with anticipation.

In these ten thousand years, they had not even met face to face, but it did not prevent everyone from pinning their hopes on Lin Yuan.

…

In the depths of the Cosmic Starry Sky.

Many a Supreme Being paid close attention to the ‘scroll’ that stretched out beneath the stars.

“The heavenly gate is about to open.”

“Hope it can be opened this time, right?”

The many Supreme Beings rapidly communicated, and while there weren’t many of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses left alive in the two-dimensional world, they were practically all the real elite or even the heritage of the major races and forces.
